The timi ng of the twelve hrs. period of working may vary based on actual requirement of the RIT ES Administration on day-to-day basis. iv) Weekly rest day to Driver One day in a week as suitable to concerned officer v) Average Km running expectation 2000 km in a Month vi) Normal running in a month All days 24 hours upto Max 2000 Km x 300 Hrs vii) Area of operation For Local Movement (i.e. up to 150 Kms from RITES Mumbai Nariman Point Offic e) & and occasionally outside Mumbai viii) Type of vehicle Maruti Suzuki Dzire/ Hyundai Xcent/ Honda A maze or equivalent ix) Contract Period 02 (Two) years X) Geographical Presence The Bidder shall have an office in Maha rashtra.

2) The rate quoted by you & accepted by RITES Ltd are inclusive of all taxes / duties and G ST and all charges, levies etc. and the rate shall be remained firm till completion of entire works in all respects and you will not be permitted to sublet the contract or any part thereo f. 3) Working Hours & Running KM Package: This package considered total running kilometer 2000 km and total working hours 300 hours (i.e. 2000kmx300Hrs in a month including driv er wages and maintenance, fuel and lubricants etc. (Driver wages will be based on 300 hrs. ) 4) Vehicle Running: The vehicle will run specifically in Mumbai city and its adjace nt area in circle of 150 Km from RITES Nariman Point office. The vehicle may be r un outside Mumbai occasionally as and when required by Officer in Charge. 5) Extra Run: GeM term & Condition in this case is null and void. Extra running will be paid @Rs 10 per Kilometer excluding GST beyond 2000 Km running in a Month. 6) Extra Duty: GeM term & Condition in this case is null and void. Extra duty hours will be p aid @Rs 120 per hour excluding GST beyond 300 hours in a Month. 7) Maintenance, repair and other charges: All kinds of repair/maintenance costs, charges of fuels, oil, lubricants, mobile phone chargers, fee towards licences/registration, challans, sal ary/overtime of the driver, upto date comprehensive insurance/Pollution certificate etc are r esponsibility of the contractor and shall be borne by the contractor throughout the duration of the contract. If there is any repair/breakdown of for more than 3 hours or in case of abs ence, applicable amount shall be deducted on pro-rata basis from your bill. 8) In case of break down of the vehicle, the contractor shall provide the replacement (of same category ve hicle) within a reasonable time failing which the touring executive will be entitled to hire any vehicle and c omplete the journey and amount thus incurred shall be recovered from the bills of the contractor. 9) The contractor shall ensure compliance of all applicable laws such as Motor vehicle act a nd adhere to legal and labour provisions provided by the Government of India/State which shall include income tax, Accidents, Employee State Insurance, Provident fund, Minimum w ages act, Contract labour and Abolition Act etc. The Contractor shall provide all the necessa ry details as required by RITES for passing the bill/invoice. Any penalty/fine imposed by State Government official's authority due to non-compliance o f statutory rules/safety rules & regulations etc. shall be borne by the service provider and will be solely responsible for follow up of the case arising due to such situation and RITES w ill be in no way responsible for such act. 10) Log Book: Vehicle should be available for 24 hours and payment shall be made for 200 0Kmx300 Hours Max package. Log book shall be maintained by driver to record the operati on time shall be signed by RITES Official. The bill shall be made on the basis of record in th e log book. The milage & time reckoning shall be recorded/counted from residence of RITE S Official in charge at Mumbai. However, Parking Charges & Toll taxes shall be reimbursed by RITES on actual basis on submission of bill. 11) Safety Rule: Successful bidder has to follow all safety precautions as imposed by Client /RITES from time to time. 12) Security of Vehicle: Security of the Vehicle deployed at site will be in bidder's scope, no thing will be charged to RITES on this account under any circumstances whatsoever. In cas e of any accident to the vehicle, it will be the responsibility of the bidders or his representat ive to lodge FIR etc. with police. All RTO issues and Traffic violations are to the account of s uccessful bidder. In such cases Driver's responsibility if any shall be taken care by bidders only. 13) Contract Period: Contract period is for 24 (Twenty-Four) months. Contract ma

y be extended beyond stipulated time or may be terminated before stipulated co ntract period at any time with 15 (fifteen) days prior notice without any financial repercussion/implication on either side. 14) The contract may be terminated in the event of recurring non-reporting of th e vehicle, frequent change of driver, refusal to comply with instructions issued b y RITES officials regarding vehicle movement, delayed reporting, or replacement/ change of the vehicle without prior intimation and approval of RITES. 15) Following categories of Sellers shall however, be exempted from furnishing Bid Security : a) Micro and Small Enterprises who are manufacturer of the Primary Product Category or Se rvice Provider of the Primary Service Category and give specific confirmation to this effect at the time of bid submission and whose credentials are validated online through Udyam R egistration/ Udyog Aadhaar (as validated by Government from time to time) and through u ploaded supporting documents. b) Start-ups as recognized by Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion (DIPP). c) KVIC, ACASH. WDO, Coir Board, TRIFED and Kendriya Bhandar. d) Sellers who have got their credentials verified through the process of Vendor Assessmen t by Vendor Assessment Agencies for the Primary Product/Primary Service for which Bid/ RA has been invited. e) Sellers/Service Provider having annual turnover of INR 500 Crore or more, at least in one of the past three completed financial year(s). f) Micro and Small Enterprises registered with NSIC for the Primary Product Category whose credentials are validated through NSIC database and through uploaded supporting docume nts. g) Micro and Small Enterprises registered with DIC for the Primary Product Category whose credentials are validated through DIC database and through uploaded supporting documen ts. h) Sellers / Service Providers holding BIS License for the Primary Product Category whose cr edentials are validated through BIS database and through uploaded supporting documents. i) Central/State PSUs. j) Seller/Service Provider registered with designated Agency/Authority as specified in the bi d document by the Buyer-such bidder shall have to upload scanned copy of relevant registr ation document in place of Bid Security document while bidding. 16) Officer-In-charge: The vehicle shall be directly reported to GGM (WRIO) Mumbai or any other person duly authorized by RITES Ltd will be the Officer for the above work. In this con nection, all communication & guidance for this work shall have to be dealt with him in the a bove address. 17) Vehicle: The Model of Vehicle considered for this bid as mentioned in the bid should be commercial registration of 2025 or latest and also should be in good c ondition, Mechanically sound and decently maintained with neat and clean seat c over etc. 18) Driver and vehicle should not be changed frequently. If any most unavoidable to circum stances bidder can change the driver/ vehicle if required, but compulsory prior intimation s hould be given to the user concerned. Driver shall be supplied by bidder. His payment shall also be under bidder's scope. Driver salary shall be paid as Per State Govt. Minimum Wages along with necessary PF as per Govt. rules. Bidder shall submit the Driver's Valid document

s required to owner for Making Gate Passes. Whenever Main Driver is in leave, bidder need s to arrange Proper alternate driver without any extra cost to owner. If the vehicle not avail able due to driver absent, then the same day will be treated as no work no pay for both the driver and vehicle hire charges. No change of vehicle(s) or driver(s) will be allowed without prior permission of RITES. The contractor shall ensure that only on pay roll drivers should be deployed for duty. The Drivers should be in proper uniform with name badges and photo Identity Card. 19) The contractor shall ensure that vehicles and the drivers are dedicated to the officer wit h whom vehicle is attached and changed only with their prior consent and with advance no tice of at least 3 days, except in emergencies. Frequent changing of drivers and bringing dr ivers from far off places without proper knowledge of roads and driving skill should be avoi ded. 20) Penalty clause: a) Late reporting-500/-Per day b) Non-reporting-5000/-Per day c) Refusal of duties: Official requirement and/or desired by Officer-1000/-Per instance d) Change of drivers: Even with prior intimation Driver change is not allowed for more than on ce in a Month. In case of non-reporting the per day rent for Vehicle on pro-rata basis will be deducted apa rt from the above penalty. Deductions shall be made in terms of penalty clause against the bills pertai ning to the days of unsatisfactory service and non-fulfillment of contract conditions as reported by the user . 21) Copies of Valid Registration Certificate, insurance, Taxes, Pollution under control certific ate & Driver’s residence address Proof has to be submitted by successful bidder to RITES O ffice. 22) Price: Rate quoted shall remain firm without any escalation on any account till the com pletion of job and the order in executed in all respects. 23) Payment Terms: Payment will be made within 30 days from the date of submission of T ax Invoice along with copy of Log sheet. No advance payment shall be entertained. 24) Along with every monthly bill vendor is supposed to get certification from the user that the vehicle ass igned is 2025 Model or Latest and having valid PUC. 25) Income Tax: Income tax will be deducted from bill as per Govt. rules. 26) Right to accept or reject the offer: The Company reserves the absolute right to reject an y or all offers and/or to cancel the Tender without assigning any reason whatsoever, thereo f. The Tenderer whose tender is not accepted shall not be entitled to claim any cost, charge s or expenses incidental to or incurred by him through or in connection with the preparatio n and submission of the offer to the Company. 27) Execution of Agreement: No separate agreement will be required to be executed. Acce ptance of this order in GeM will be treated as Agreement for all purpose. 28) Successful Bidder has to submit documents as mentioned in point No. 20. Based on the se documents, contract shall be awarded to successful Bidder. 29) The Agency can utilize parking space, if available, for vehicle at RITES officer residence/RITES Office o r Agency should arrange their own parking arrangement. Bidders shall also note that no extra payment ot her than Extra Hour Charges will be paid to bidder in case vehicle is utilized during night time. 30) The contractor shall ensure that the tanks of the vehicle supplied are fully filled with diesel/petrol/CNG

before they are sent for duty, and the vehicle shall be equipped with FASTag facility with sufficient ba lance. 31) Security Deposit amount will be deducted to 5% of the tender value of work. Security Dep osit, a sum at the rate of 5% of the gross amount of each running bill and final bill, will be ded ucted. As soon as the contract period is ended and after release of final bill payment, on reque st of the contractor, the Security Deposit money will be released. 32) Agencies which are MSME Should be registered on eTreds portal. Upload TReDs registratio n document on GEM portal while bidding. 33) Other Terms and Conditions will be governed by extant rule available in GEM. 34) Payment through TReDS: In the case of eligible MSME suppliers, payment shall be processe d through the TReDS portal of Govt of India, for which vendor needs to get registered on respectiv e portal. 35)Bill submission: Vendor has to submit scan copy of the bill thorough RITES Vendor Portal (VP TP).
